privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: We keep as little about you as possible, explain exactly what and why, and let you take it with you or delete it at any time.

short.title: The short version
short.p1: Browsing and watching needs no account. An account is only needed to rate and react.
short.p2: For an account we keep your email, display name, a scrambled (hashed) password and when you accepted this notice.
short.p3: No analytics, no ads, no trackers, no IP addresses. One essential cookie keeps you logged in.
short.p4: Your watch progress never leaves your browser.
short.p5: Download your data or delete your account yourself, any time, from “My account”.
short.p6: Thumbnails and covers come from our own server, and what you type in search is never stored on your device: nothing from YouTube or any other site loads until you press Play.

keep.title: What we keep, why and for how long
keep.intro: This is everything we store on our server that relates to you:

users.name: Your account
users.what: Email, display name, password hash (scrypt), date you accepted the privacy notice
users.why: To log you in, show your name in your account menu and prove your consent
users.until: You delete your account. Accounts never verified are deleted automatically after 7 days.

sessions.name: Login sessions
sessions.what: A SHA-256 fingerprint of your session token, your user id, expiry date
sessions.until: Expiry (30 days) — removed automatically; or when you log out / sign out everywhere

tokens.name: Email links
tokens.what: A SHA-256 fingerprint of the link's token, your user id, expiry date
tokens.why: To verify your email address or reset your password
tokens.until: Used or expired (24 hours to verify, 1 hour to reset) — removed automatically

ratings.name: Ratings
ratings.what: Your user id, the video, your score (1–5) and optional reaction
ratings.until: You remove the rating or delete your account. If the video is moved to the trash, its ratings are kept for up to 7 more days and can’t be changed while it is there; then they are deleted with it.

activity.name: Rating activity (not personal data)
activity.what: Anonymous daily totals per video (number of ratings, sum of scores) — no user id

privacy.never: We do not store IP addresses, browser user agents, analytics, advertising IDs or any third-party trackers.

device.title: Stored only on your device
device.intro: Some things are saved only in your browser (in localStorage and, for offline use, in Cache Storage). They never reach our server:
device.progress: Watch progress (key crwn:progress:v1): for up to 200 videos — the position, the length, when you last watched, and the episode's link, title and thumbnail, so we can show “Resume at…”, ✓ marks and “Continue watching”.
device.prefs: Preferences: theme (light/dark), language, “Autoplay next” and “Always load YouTube”.
device.cache: Offline copy (Cache Storage): the app itself and the public catalog pages you opened — lists, series, episodes, thumbnails and covers — so the site opens without internet. What you type in search is never stored there, nor anything from your account, your ratings or other personal data. Each new version of the site deletes the previous copy.
device.clear: You can clear your watch history at any time, even without an account. “Clear watch history” deletes your progress and the offline copy of catalog pages and images (the app itself stays, so it still opens offline):

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: We use a single cookie, sid. It is strictly necessary: it only exists while you are logged in, is unreadable by scripts (httpOnly), is only sent to this site (SameSite=Lax) and expires after 30 days.
cookies.p2: Because it is essential for a service you asked for, it doesn't need a consent banner. We use no analytics, advertising or social media cookies.

youtube.title: Videos, thumbnails and covers
youtube.p1: Every episode is a YouTube video. Episode thumbnails and series covers are now served from our own server (it fetches them from their source and keeps a copy), so opening a page doesn't make your browser contact YouTube, Google or any other site: YouTube is only contacted when you press Play.
youtube.p2: The YouTube player is only loaded after you press play (or if you switch on “Always load YouTube”). It uses YouTube's privacy-enhanced domain youtube-nocookie.com, but once it plays, Google's own privacy policy applies to what happens inside the player.
youtube.p3: If you prefer, use “Watch on YouTube” to open a video directly on youtube.com.

email.title: Emails
email.p1: We only send emails you need: the verification link, password reset links and a notice when your password changes. The language you choose is used only to write that one email and is not stored.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.contract: Providing your account, logins and ratings: performance of a contract (GDPR art. 6(1)(b); LGPD art. 7, V).
basis.consent: Recording that you accepted this notice: to demonstrate compliance (GDPR art. 7(1); LGPD art. 8, §2).
basis.legit: Security measures such as rate limiting and hashed tokens: legitimate interest in keeping accounts safe (GDPR art. 6(1)(f); LGPD art. 7, IX).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: Under the GDPR (RGPD) and Brazil's LGPD you can:

access.name: Access & portability
access.how: “Download my data” in My account gives you everything we keep about you as a JSON file.

rectify.name: Rectification
rectify.how: Change your display name in My account. To change your email, contact us.

erase.name: Erasure
erase.how: “Delete my account” erases your account, sessions and ratings immediately.

object.name: Objection & restriction
object.how: Contact us and we'll answer within 15 days (LGPD) / one month (GDPR).

complain.name: Complaint
complain.how: You can complain to your data protection authority — in Brazil the ANPD, in the EU your national authority.

security.title: Security
security.p1: Passwords are stored only as scrypt hashes; session and email tokens only as SHA-256 fingerprints. The site is served over HTTPS with a strict Content Security Policy. Changing or resetting your password signs out your other devices.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p1: The Crwn Animes team is the data controller. For any privacy question or request, write to the contact address published by the site operator; we never ask for more data than needed to answer.
